Required action: any Rule 4 finding (per `.claude/rules/auto-correct-scope.md`) must STOP fixing and be routed to `ESCALATIONS.md` (or directly to the user if standalone) instead of being auto-fixed.

Key safety gate: Rule 1–3 findings may be corrected inline, but Rule 4 is a hard STOP — the finding is recorded as a blocker with `decision: pending`, and `ESCALATIONS.md` is deny-on-no-response (enforced by `hooks/commit-quality-gate.sh`), so work touching that spec stays blocked until a human records an explicit decision.
